title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!

Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

title: AML/CFT Compliance Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance AML/CFT and sanctions policies in alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Act as a primary compliance interface with regulators, including managing inspections, responding to inquiries, and executing remediation plans.
  • Perform risk-based customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews for both individuals and corporate clients.
  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including transaction surveillance, sanctions screening, and the investigation of alerts or potentially suspicious behaviors.
  • Prepare, review, and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory filings to COAF or relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.
  • Hands-on expertise in KYC/KYB processes, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; postgraduate studies or professional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
  • Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: GCP Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for GCP Data Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub

Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL

Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)

Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)

Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization

GCP certifications

Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP

Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)

Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures

Understanding of Data Lake layers

Knowledge of batch and streaming processing

Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and NoSQL)

Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.

Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.

Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.

Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.

Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.

Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.

Implement best practices for DataOps and Data Governance.


BigQuery, Dataflow, AlloyDB, APIGee (focus in GCP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for GCP Data Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub

Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL

Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)

Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)

Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization

GCP certifications

Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP

Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)

Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures

Understanding of Data Lake layers

Knowledge of batch and streaming processing

Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and NoSQL)

Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.

Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.

Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.

Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.

Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.

Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.

Implement best practices for DataOps and Data Governance.


BigQuery, Dataflow, AlloyDB, APIGee (focus in GCP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Childcare assistance

Gympass

International experience opportunity

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

title: Editor de vídeos curtos (shorts / Reels / TikTok)
description:
A MLPro está buscando um editor de vídeos freelancer para nos apoiar na criação de shorts para YouTube, Reels e TikTok , a partir de vídeos longos já gravados.


Nosso conteúdo é técnico/educacional , focado em Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, PMO e gestão de projetos, para serem publicados nas nossas redes sociais e Youtube (@MLProPPM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Cortar trechos de vídeos longos para criar shorts de até 40–60 segundos .
  • Adaptar do formato horizontal para vertical (9:16), mantendo bom enquadramento.
  • Inserir legendas dinâmicas , com destaque em palavras-chave, sem erros de português.
  • Seguir a identidade visual da MLPro  (cores, logo e estilo mais sóbrio, não infantil).
  • Entregar arquivos em alta qualidade, prontos para publicação nas redes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (shorts, Reels, TikTok).
  • Portfólio específico de shorts/ vídeos curtos  já publicados.
  • Atenção a detalhes de áudio, texto e ritmo de edição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com conteúdo técnico/educacional.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Vaga 100% remota, formato freelancer.
  • Pacote inicial mensal de vídeos curtos, com possibilidade de expansão conforme resultados.


Na candidatura pelo LinkedIn, anexe seu portfólio de vídeos curtos  (documento com links dos vídeos) no campo de currículo (CV) . Candidaturas sem portfólio de vídeos curtos  não serão consideradas.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de sistemas
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.


Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.

description:
We’re seeking a hands-on Product Owner to drive the implementation of Loyalty and Marketing Automation platforms for LATAM markets.

  • 5–8 years’ experience as a Product Owner , Business Analyst , or similar in marketing tech or CRM.

  • Familiarity with MarTech tools – CDPs, loyalty/promo engines, and automation platforms.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish or Portuguese .

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

English fluently

Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-disciplinary research environment.

title: Programa Trainee Inetum Brasil – SAP
description:
Programa de Trainee Inetum Brasil – SAP (Jan/2026)


A Inetum é um grupo global de serviços de TI presente em mais de 19 países, com aproximadamente 24.000 colaboradores. No Brasil, reúne mais de 350 profissionais e integra uma rede de 1.800 colaboradores na América Latina. Fundada na Europa, consolidou-se como referência em consultoria e soluções digitais, apoiando organizações a aproveitarem a capacidade de se adaptar continuamente às transformações tecnológicas e às demandas do mercado.


Objetivo do Programa

Formar jovens talentos para atuar na área de consultoria SAP, desenvolvendo competências técnicas e comportamentais nos módulos MM, FI, SD, PM e PS, com foco em inovação, colaboração e excelência na entrega de projetos.


Estrutura

• Início: Janeiro de 2026

• Duração: Programa de desenvolvimento contínuo

• Formato: 100% remoto

• Regime: CLT


Etapas


1. Seleção (Dezembro/2025)

• Inscrições online

• Avaliação de currículo

• Dinâmica de grupo

• Entrevista técnica com especialistas SAP


2. Onboarding (Janeiro/2026)

• Integração cultural e apresentação da Inetum Brasil

• Introdução às práticas e valores da empresa


3. Formação Técnica (Janeiro–Março/2026)

• Treinamentos em metodologias ágeis e soft skills

• Capacitação intensiva nos módulos SAP: MM, FI, SD, PM e PS

• Workshops práticos com simulações de projetos reais


4. Experiência em Projetos (Março–Dezembro/2026)

• Participação em projetos reais sob supervisão de consultores seniores

• Rotação entre diferentes módulos para ampliar a visão sistêmica


5. Avaliação Final (Dezembro/2026)

• Feedback 360° (mentores, gestores e colegas)

• Possibilidade de promoção para Consultor Júnior SAP


Perfil do Candidato

• Recém-formados ou estudantes em fase final de graduação em Administração, Engenharias, TI, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês intermediário/avançado (desejável)

• Interesse em tecnologia e consultoria SAP

• Boa comunicação, proatividade e espírito de equipe

• Desejável conhecimento básico em SAP, seja por experiência como key user ou por participação em academia de formação.


Benefícios

• Contratação CLT + benefícios;

• Trabalho 100% remoto

• Plano de carreira estruturado

• Treinamentos contínuos em SAP

• Mentoria com profissionais experientes

A Inetum é um grupo global de serviços de TI presente em mais de 19 países, com aproximadamente 24.000 colaboradores. No Brasil, reúne mais de 350 profissionais e integra uma rede de 1.800 colaboradores na América Latina. Fundada na Europa, consolidou-se como referência em consultoria e soluções digitais, apoiando organizações a aproveitarem a capacidade de se adaptar continuamente às transformações tecnológicas e às demandas do mercado.


Objetivo do Programa

Formar jovens talentos para atuar na área de consultoria SAP, desenvolvendo competências técnicas e comportamentais nos módulos MM, FI, SD, PM e PS, com foco em inovação, colaboração e excelência na entrega de projetos.


Estrutura

• Início: Janeiro de 2026

• Duração: Programa de desenvolvimento contínuo

• Formato: 100% remoto

• Regime: CLT


Etapas


1. Seleção (Dezembro/2025)

• Inscrições online

• Avaliação de currículo

• Dinâmica de grupo

• Entrevista técnica com especialistas SAP


2. Onboarding (Janeiro/2026)

• Integração cultural e apresentação da Inetum Brasil

• Introdução às práticas e valores da empresa


3. Formação Técnica (Janeiro–Março/2026)

• Treinamentos em metodologias ágeis e soft skills

• Capacitação intensiva nos módulos SAP: MM, FI, SD, PM e PS

• Workshops práticos com simulações de projetos reais


4. Experiência em Projetos (Março–Dezembro/2026)

• Participação em projetos reais sob supervisão de consultores seniores

• Rotação entre diferentes módulos para ampliar a visão sistêmica


5. Avaliação Final (Dezembro/2026)

• Feedback 360° (mentores, gestores e colegas)

• Possibilidade de promoção para Consultor Júnior SAP


Perfil do Candidato

• Recém-formados ou estudantes em fase final de graduação em Administração, Engenharias, TI, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês intermediário/avançado (desejável)

• Interesse em tecnologia e consultoria SAP

• Boa comunicação, proatividade e espírito de equipe

• Desejável conhecimento básico em SAP, seja por experiência como key user ou por participação em academia de formação.


Benefícios

• Contratação CLT + benefícios;

• Trabalho 100% remoto

• Plano de carreira estruturado

• Treinamentos contínuos em SAP

• Mentoria com profissionais experientes

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: BD(Recruited Agencies)
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: Desenvolvedor da Microsoft
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Desenvolvedor Microsoft Power Automate , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver fluxos de trabalho personalizados utilizando a plataforma Microsoft Power Automate .

Projetar, criar e manter fluxos, ações e gatilhos para atender às necessidades do negócio.

Integrar o Power Automate com outras ferramentas do ecossistema Microsoft (SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics, etc.).

Criar e manter documentação técnica para apoiar o desenvolvimento e manutenção das soluções automatizadas.

Garantir a qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade das soluções implementadas.


Competências Técnicas:

Experiência comprovada com Microsoft Power Automate (criação de fluxos complexos, conectores, expressões).

Conhecimento em Power Apps e Power BI será considerado um diferencial.

Familiaridade com SharePoint Online , Microsoft Teams e Dynamics 365 .

Habilidade para trabalhar com APIs REST , JSON e integrações entre sistemas.

Capacidade de criar soluções escaláveis e seguras.


Formação: Ciência da Computação, engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas.



O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior Backend - PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Modelo de contratação PJ.


O Engenheiro de Software Sênior Backend (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

  • Participar ativamente das etapas de desenvolvimento e entrega de funcionalidades;
  • Compreender rapidamente o domínio do projeto e o funcionamento da aplicação;
  • Propor e implementar soluções de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time em decisões técnicas;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de produto, design e outras áreas técnicas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) com Ruby on Rails em produção;
  • Proficiência com ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, RSpec, Devise e outras gems amplamente utilizadas;
  • Domínio de banco de dados relacional (preferencialmente PostgreSQL);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Capacidade de navegação e evolução em bases de código existentes;
  • Escrita de código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Hotwire/Turbo;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com integração a serviços externos (ex: Stripe, AWS, SendGrid);
  • Fluência em ambientes ágeis com squads enxutos.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Especialista Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


Oportunidade: Especialista Azure

A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataforma Microsoft Azure . A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase em Azure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.


Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
  • Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
  • Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou ExpressRoute.
  • Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
  • Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
  • Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio comprovado em Azure Network (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
  • Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
  • Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
  • Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.


Contratação CLT

Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.


O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

• Programação;

• Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

• Python;

• PySpark;

• SQL.

Ferramentas:

Big Data:

• HUE;

• Hive;

• Spark (SparkML);

• NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

• DB2;

• MySQL;

• Oracle;

• Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).

• Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)

• Versionamento de código (Git)


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA RPA PL - REMOTO
description:

title: Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager
description:
Position Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager 

Organization SalesSparx LLC 

Location Latin America, EMEA (Remote) 

Contract Type Full-time 

We Are SalesSparx – This Is What We Do  


SalesSparx, founded in 2015, is a boutique consulting firm on a mission to accelerate healthcare innovation. We help high-growth companies, especially those selling technology and services to health systems, scale smarter and faster. Our focus is go-to-market (GTM) strategy, sales enablement, and training execution. 


We’re not just advisors, we’re builders, operators, and trusted partners to the C-suite. At SalesSparx, you’ll get a front-row seat to how real healthcare business gets done, working directly with CEOs, founders, and executive teams. 


We operate in a high-performance, client-first environment where team members are empowered to take ownership, think strategically, and drive outcomes. Whether you're managing projects, leading accounts, or building internal capabilities, your work will shape the growth trajectory of companies at the forefront of healthcare transformation. 


We value curiosity, accountability, and execution. If you thrive in fast-paced settings, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to accelerate your career alongside a team that’s redefining how healthcare companies go to market, this is the place to do it. 


SalesSparx by the Numbers  

  • Have served over 100 healthcare software, consulting and technology firms 
  • 10K+ hours of sales best practice research 
  • $1B+ client bookings 
  • SVS Process used to manage 50K+ sales opportunities per year 
  • 9.9/10 Client Net Promoter Score 
  • Published Light Your Sales FUSE in 2023, the only Healthcare-focused Sales Acceleration Guide in the industry 


Opportunity  


The Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager leads the operational backbone behind SalesSparx’s internal training systems, documentation structure, and methodology governance. 


This professional maintains the single source of truth for internal processes, training curricula, templates, and onboarding structures. They ensure consultants follow the right learning paths, have access to accurate materials, and that our methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) remain organized, structured, and current. 


This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role focused on execution, documentation discipline, and content operations, in additional to management responsibilities. In the short term this person will develop the content to support our operational process and over time will build up its own team. 


What You’ll Do  

Process Documentation & Knowledge Extraction  

  • Interview team members, shadow workflows, and extract tribal knowledge. 
  • Translate informal processes into clear documentation, SOPs, and structured modules. 
  • Maintain an organized, version-controlled process repository. 
  • Ensure internal methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) are accurately documented and regularly updated. 

Template Governance & Content Maintenance  

  • Own the lifecycle and organization of: SVS materials, Go-to-Market assets and Internal consulting templates 
  • Audit and update templates on a defined cadence. 
  • Enforce consistency, version control, and internal standards for all materials. 
  • Maintain a centralized template library that is easy for consultants to access and navigate. 

Training Curriculum & LMS Development  

  • Convert existing training materials into structured LMS modules. 
  • Build quizzes, assessments, practice exercises, and progress tracking workflows. 
  • Maintain curriculum versions and ensure training content remains aligned to current methodology. 
  • Support training execution logistics (materials prep, assignments, communications). 

Onboarding Coordination  

  • Build a structured onboarding flow for new consultants. 
  • Ensure every new hire follows the correct learning path and completes required modules. 
  • Track onboarding progress and report on readiness or gaps. 
  • Provide execution support to the team members leading training sessions. 

Learning Path Compliance & Monitoring  

  • Track consultant participation in learning paths. 
  • Follow up on incomplete modules and escalate when needed. 
  • Maintain dashboards or tracking sheets for enablement completion. 
  • Ensure training compliance is consistently monitored and documented. 

Who We’re Looking For  


Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, Education, Sales, Communications, or related fields. 
  • Master’s degree preferred (Education, Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Curriculum & Instruction, or similar). 


Experience  

  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.
  • Experience on working in a Management Consulting or a Law firm is required
  • 5+ years in roles such as: Training Coordinator, Instructional Design Specialist, Enablement Coordinator, Curriculum Development Assistant, Knowledge Management Specialist, or Process Documentation/PMO Support. 
  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.  
  • Experience building training materials, documenting processes, and maintaining structured content repositories. 
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, learning paths, assessments, and completion tracking. 
  • Experience in process-driven, documentation-heavy environments. 
  • No prior healthcare experience required. 


Skills  

  • Fluent written and spoken English. 
  • Capable to work on EST hours. 
  • Strong organizational discipline in a fully remote environment. 
  • Ability to extract insights from SMEs and convert them into structured content. 
  • Comfort building onboarding flows, training assets, and learning materials.

title: Pessoa Analista Funcional - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um Analista Funcional - Sênior, para trabalhar com um banco que entende as necessidades, inova nas soluções e atende com excelência os seus clientes. Estão em um momento de grande evolução de serviços, com forte entrada em soluções digitais para mercado de câmbio (PF e PJ) e serviços de FX as a Service para fintechs e parceiros do mercado financeiro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

· Levantamento e análise de requisitos: investigar necessidades dos usuários, definir escopo e documentar requisitos.

· Facilitar a comunicação: atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio e equipe técnica, garantindo entendimento mútuo.

· Mapeamento de processos: identificar fluxos de trabalho e propor melhorias para otimizar sistemas.

· Documentação funcional: elaborar especificações detalhadas que orientem desenvolvedores e testadores.

· Validação e testes: acompanhar implementação, realizar testes funcionais e validar entregas.

· Gestão de stakeholders: conduzir reuniões, alinhar expectativas e garantir que soluções atendam objetivos estratégicos.


Requisitos e qualificações

· Capacidade analítica: interpretar dados e processos para propor soluções eficazes.

· Comunicação clara: transmitir informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos e vice-versa.

· Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban ou similares, para facilitar projetos de TI.

· Visão de negócio: compreender objetivos estratégicos da empresa e alinhar soluções tecnológicas.

· Proatividade e organização: antecipar problemas, estruturar demandas e manter documentação atualizada.

· Conhecimento técnico básico: entender conceitos de sistemas, bancos de dados e integrações, mesmo sem ser desenvolvedor.


Diferenciais valorizados no mercado:

· Experiência prévia em consultoria ou projetos de transformação digital.

· Certificações como CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) ou PO/SM em Scrum.

· Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem de processos (ex.: Bizagi, Visio).

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: JDE Developer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


JDE Developer

Position Summary:

The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation , initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other Gallagher applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Skills Required:

• Technical experience of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Advanced in Spanish/Advanced English


Desired:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Technology project support experience

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Work Traits:

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Ability to work at a fast pace and cope with conflicting deadlines

• Proven ability to deliver excellent customer service

• Good analytical and problem solving skills

• Strong attention to detail


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote


************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************


Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.


This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It’s a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.


  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.


  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.


  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.


  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).


  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.


  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.



Skills & Qualifications :


  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.


  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.


  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.


  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.


  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.


  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.


  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.


This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.
